import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from cfg.loader import load, load_ini


def _write(directory, name, text):
    path = Path(directory) / name
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return str(path)


class LoaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_step1_load_ini(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = _write(tmp, "a.ini", "[db]\nhost = x\n")
            self.assertEqual(load_ini(path), {"db": {"host": "x"}})

    def test_step2_load_dispatches_ini(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = _write(tmp, "a.ini", "[db]\nhost = x\n")
            self.assertEqual(load(path), {"db": {"host": "x"}})

    def test_step3_defaults_merge(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = _write(tmp, "a.json", json.dumps({"db": {"host": "x"}}))
            merged = load(path, defaults={"db": {"host": "d", "port": "1"}})
            self.assertEqual(merged, {"db": {"host": "x", "port": "1"}})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from cfg.loader import load


class FollowupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ini_with_defaults(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path = Path(tmp) / "b.ini"
            path.write_text("[db]\nhost = y\n", encoding="utf-8")
            merged = load(str(path), defaults={"cache": {"ttl": "5"}})
            self.assertEqual(merged, {"cache": {"ttl": "5"}, "db": {"host": "y"}})

    def test_progress_records_step_3_done(self):
        progress = Path("PROGRESS.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("- [x] Step 3", progress)
